highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves WebGPU packaging and reduces allocations in image and HarfBuzz text processing.
highlights_body: Android continuous texture rendering now follows the display refresh rate, and front-buffered streams release their source stream when disposed.

bullets.lead: WebGPU support is packaged with native WebAssembly assets
bullets.detail: The emdawnwebgpu implementation is now built into libSkiaSharp.a, so browser applications no longer compile its C++ source during their own link step.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: GLTextureView continuous rendering is paced by Android frame callbacks, coalescing requests and avoiding queued frames while the surface is active.
Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream now clears its managed stream reference whether or not it owns the underlying stream.
SKImage pixel copies use pinned input memory when valid, while HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding and feature formatting reuse stack or pooled buffers to reduce transient allocations.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Packaged the emdawnwebgpu implementation with SkiaSharp's WebAssembly native assets
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Improved Blazor CPU sample test reliability by waiting for the first canvas paint
